title: Residue layer tensors in the explicit uniformizer filtration
statement: Fix the coefficient fields, completed scalar map and a good complex P of [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension] and [lem-pur-integral-operations-well-defined]. For n>=0 let B=ULift(O_L/pi_L^(n+1)) and let F_j be the j-th power of the ideal generated by the image of pi_L, for 0<=j<=n+1. If the source residue derived reduction is intrinsically bounded constructible [def-weil-finite-torsion-constructibility] with support in [r,s] [def-weil-cohomological-support], then every complex P tensor_R (F_j/F_(j+1))_Y, in the associative presentation [lem-sf-filtered-coefficient-tensor-bounds], has constructible homology over B in every degree and vanishes outside [r,s]. No assertion about the tensor with the whole B-module is included.

proof.text: Construct F_j as the actual power ideal of the image of pi_L in B. Power ideal monotonicity proves antitonicity; power zero is the top ideal; the defining quotient kills power n+1. These statements are proved in Lean, without a postponed construction.
Prove the constructibility and out-of-interval clauses by the two residue-layer subtheorems, which isolate the finite-residue extension and support transport. Combine their conclusions pointwise.

Compute source residue reduction on K-flat P, then use the balanced associator to identify the layer tensor with finite-field scalar extension of this residue complex. The exact finite-field functor preserves constructibility and the same interval. Restrict the finite residue models to B; this keeps finite constants and vanishing. The equivalence of finite-model and geometric-stalk constructibility and the localization homology comparison give the displayed layer assertions, including exponent one, zero complexes and empty schemes.

theorem integralScalarResidueLayers_bounds
    (D : FiniteFieldDatum.{d}) (hl : l ≠ D.p)
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E Y).FullSubcategory)
    (r s : ℤ) (hrs : r ≤ s)
    (h₁ : intrinsicFiniteTorsionConstructible l E 1 (by omega) Y
      ((integralDerivedReduction l E Y D hl 0).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)))
    (hbound : ∀ i : ℤ,
      i ∈ proEtaleCohomologicalSupport
        ((integralDerivedReduction l E Y D hl 0).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj P.obj)) →
      r ≤ i ∧ i ≤ s) (n : ℕ) :
    letI := Padic.finite_coefficientExtensionRing l L (n + 1) (by omega)
    let B := ULift.{u + 1} (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l L (n + 1))
    let F := integralScalarPowerFiltration l L n
    ∀ (j : Fin (n + 1)) (i : ℤ),
      IsConstructibleProEtaleCoefficientModuleSheaf Y B
        ((filteredCoefficientTensorComplex Y B
          (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E Y)
          (integralScalarRho l E L ι Y n) P.obj
          (ModuleCat.of B ((F j.castSucc) ⧸
            (F j.succ).comap (F j.castSucc).subtype))).homology i) ∧
      ((i < r ∨ s < i) → IsZero
        ((filteredCoefficientTensorComplex Y B
          (completedIntegralCommRingSheafUnrestricted l E Y)
          (integralScalarRho l E L ι Y n) P.obj
          (ModuleCat.of B ((F j.castSucc) ⧸
            (F j.succ).comap (F j.castSucc).subtype))).homology i))
